MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 3 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 8
   C. 6
   D. 3

2. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 1
   C. 72
   D. 17

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 5

5. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 32

6. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 12

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

8. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

9. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 26

11. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

13. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 18

14. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

15. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 56
   C. 15
   D. 1

16. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 20
   C. 1
   D. 9

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
